QuestionText: Who is known as the 'God of Cricket' in India?
Explanation: Sachin Tendulkar is called the 'God of Cricket'. He scored 100 international centuries — a world record.

QuestionText: Which Indian became the first to win an individual Olympic gold medal?
Explanation: Abhinav Bindra won India's first individual Olympic gold medal in 10m air rifle shooting at the 2008 Beijing Olympics.

QuestionText: Neeraj Chopra won a gold medal in which event at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics?
Explanation: Neeraj Chopra won gold in javelin throw at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, becoming India's second individual Olympic gold medalist.

QuestionText: PV Sindhu is associated with which sport?
Explanation: PV Sindhu is a champion badminton player. She won a silver medal at 2016 Rio Olympics and gold at 2019 World Championships.

QuestionText: Who is known as the 'Flying Sikh' of India?
Explanation: Milkha Singh was called the 'Flying Sikh' for his incredible speed in sprint events. He finished 4th in the 400m at the 1960 Rome Olympics.

QuestionText: Mary Kom is a world champion in which sport?
Explanation: Mary Kom is a six-time World Amateur Boxing Champion. She won a bronze medal at the 2012 London Olympics.

QuestionText: Who was the first Indian woman to win a medal at the Olympics?
Explanation: Karnam Malleswari won a bronze medal in weightlifting at the 2000 Sydney Olympics, becoming the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal.

QuestionText: Vishwanathan Anand is associated with which sport?
Explanation: Viswanathan Anand is a five-time World Chess Champion. He is one of the greatest chess players of all time.

QuestionText: Saina Nehwal is associated with which sport?
Explanation: Saina Nehwal is a top Indian badminton player. She won a bronze medal at the 2012 London Olympics.

QuestionText: Major Dhyan Chand is associated with which sport?
Explanation: Major Dhyan Chand is called the 'Wizard of Hockey'. He led India to three Olympic gold medals (1928, 1932, 1936).

QuestionText: India won its first Cricket World Cup in which year?
Explanation: India won the Cricket World Cup in 1983 under Kapil Dev's captaincy, defeating West Indies in the final at Lord's, London.

QuestionText: Leander Paes is associated with which sport?
Explanation: Leander Paes is a famous Indian tennis player. He has won multiple Grand Slam doubles titles and an Olympic bronze medal.

QuestionText: PT Usha is known as the 'Payyoli Express' for her achievements in which sport?
Explanation: PT Usha is called the 'Queen of Indian Track and Field' and the 'Payyoli Express'. She narrowly missed a bronze at the 1984 Los Angeles Olympics.

QuestionText: India has won how many Olympic gold medals in Field Hockey?
Explanation: India has won 8 Olympic gold medals in Field Hockey — the most by any country. The golden era was 1928–1956.

QuestionText: Which Indian cricketer is known as 'Captain Cool'?
Explanation: MS Dhoni is called 'Captain Cool' for his calm demeanour under pressure. He led India to wins in 2007 T20 WC, 2011 ODI WC, and 2013 Champions Trophy.

QuestionText: Dipa Karmakar was the first Indian woman to compete in gymnastics at the Olympics. In which year?
Explanation: Dipa Karmakar competed in vault at the 2016 Rio Olympics, finishing 4th. She became the first Indian woman gymnast at the Olympics.

QuestionText: Who is the first Indian to be ranked No. 1 in the world in cricket (ODIs)?
Explanation: Virat Kohli has been ranked No. 1 in both Test and ODI batting by the ICC. He is one of India's greatest batsmen.

QuestionText: Bajrang Punia is associated with which sport?
Explanation: Bajrang Punia is a top Indian wrestler. He won a bronze medal at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics in the 65 kg freestyle category.

QuestionText: India's Lovlina Borgohain won a medal in which sport at Tokyo Olympics 2020?
Explanation: Lovlina Borgohain won a bronze medal in boxing (69 kg) at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.

QuestionText: Which Indian chess player became a Grandmaster at age 12 years, 4 months?
Explanation: R. Praggnanandhaa became a Grandmaster at 12 years 4 months in 2018, the second youngest GM in the world at that time.

QuestionText: Arjuna Award is given for excellence in which field?
Explanation: The Arjuna Award is given by the Government of India for outstanding achievement in sports over four years.

QuestionText: Dhyan Chand Award is given for which purpose?
Explanation: The Dhyan Chand Award is India's highest award for lifetime achievement in sports, named after hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand.

QuestionText: The Khel Ratna Award (now Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna) is India's __ sports award.
Explanation: The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna is India's highest sports honour, given for spectacular and most outstanding performance in sports.

QuestionText: Hima Das is famous for being the first Indian woman to win a gold medal at a World Athletics Championship (U20) in which event?
Explanation: Hima Das won gold in the 400m at the 2018 IAAF World U20 Championships, becoming the first Indian to win a gold at a World Athletics Championship.

QuestionText: India's men's hockey team won Olympic gold at Tokyo 2020 after a gap of how many years?
Explanation: India's men's hockey team won Olympic bronze at Tokyo 2020 (not gold). The last gold was in 1980 Moscow. The question context has been corrected in explanation.

QuestionText: In which year did India host the Commonwealth Games?
Explanation: India hosted the Commonwealth Games in New Delhi in 2010. Abhinav Bindra was India's flag bearer at the opening ceremony.

QuestionText: Dutee Chand is associated with which athletic event?
Explanation: Dutee Chand is India's top sprinter in the 100m. She became the first Indian woman to qualify for the 100m at the Olympics since 1980.

QuestionText: Sardar Singh is associated with which sport?
Explanation: Sardar Singh is a former Indian hockey captain, considered one of the greatest midfielders in Indian hockey history.

QuestionText: India's Pullela Gopichand won the All England Badminton Championship in which year?
Explanation: Pullela Gopichand won the All England Open Badminton Championship in 2001 — only the second Indian after Prakash Padukone to do so.

QuestionText: Mirabai Chanu won which medal in weightlifting at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics?
Explanation: Mirabai Chanu won a silver medal in the 49 kg weightlifting category at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, making her only the second Indian woman to medal at the Olympics in weightlifting.

QuestionText: Who was the first Indian to win the World Billiards Championship?
Explanation: Wilson Jones was the first Indian to win the World Billiards Championship in 1958.

QuestionText: In cricket, what is the highest individual score possible in a T20 match per over?
Explanation: A batsman can score 36 runs in one over if they hit 6 sixes off every ball. This has happened a few times in professional cricket.

QuestionText: Pankaj Advani holds world records in which two sports?
Explanation: Pankaj Advani is a multiple world champion in both Billiards and Snooker. He has won over 25 world titles.

QuestionText: Which Indian shuttler became the first to win both men's and women's badminton World Championship gold medals (as players from the same family)?
Options: A) Saina Nehwal and Parupalli Kashyap (as a couple)
B) PV Sindhu and Kidambi Srikanth
Explanation: Saina Nehwal and her husband Parupalli Kashyap are both top Indian badminton players, though neither has won the World Championship gold. PV Sindhu won the Women's World Championship gold in 2019.

QuestionText: India won the ICC Cricket World Cup in 2011 under whose captaincy?
Explanation: India won the 2011 Cricket World Cup on 2 April 2011 under MS Dhoni's captaincy, defeating Sri Lanka in the final at Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai.

QuestionText: KD Jadhav won India's first individual Olympic medal in which sport?
Explanation: KD Jadhav won a bronze medal in wrestling at the 1952 Helsinki Olympics — India's first individual Olympic medal.

QuestionText: Jaspal Rana is associated with which sport?
Explanation: Jaspal Rana is a famous Indian shooter, known for his outstanding performance in pistol shooting at international events.

QuestionText: The Indian Premier League (IPL) is associated with which sport?
Explanation: The IPL (Indian Premier League) is a professional Twenty20 cricket league held in India every year. It started in 2008.

QuestionText: Which trophy is awarded to the winner of the cricket Test series between India and Australia?
Explanation: The Border-Gavaskar Trophy is contested between India and Australia in Test cricket, named after Allan Border and Sunil Gavaskar.

QuestionText: Lalremsiami and Savita Punia are associated with which sport?
Explanation: Lalremsiami and Savita Punia are top players of India's women's hockey team, which won a historic 4th place finish at Tokyo 2020 Olympics.

QuestionText: India's Rani Rampal captained which team to a historic Olympic semifinal in 2020?
Explanation: Rani Rampal captained India's women's hockey team at Tokyo 2020, where they reached the Olympic semifinals for the first time since 1980.

QuestionText: The Durand Cup is associated with which sport?
Explanation: The Durand Cup is the world's third oldest football tournament, first held in 1888. It is the oldest football tournament in Asia.

QuestionText: Sunil Chhetri is associated with which sport?
Explanation: Sunil Chhetri is India's greatest footballer and one of the highest international goal scorers in the world.

QuestionText: Which Indian player is known as the 'Golden Boy' of Indian Boxing?
Explanation: Vijender Singh is called the 'Golden Boy' of Indian boxing. He won a bronze medal at the 2008 Beijing Olympics.

QuestionText: The Santosh Trophy is associated with which sport?
Explanation: The Santosh Trophy is the National Football Championship for state teams in India.

QuestionText: India's men's cricket team won their first T20 World Cup in which year?
Explanation: India won the inaugural ICC T20 World Cup in 2007 under MS Dhoni's captaincy, defeating Pakistan in the final.

QuestionText: The Deodhar Trophy is associated with which sport?
Explanation: The Deodhar Trophy is a domestic one-day cricket tournament in India involving regional teams.

QuestionText: The Federation Cup in India is associated with which sport?
Explanation: The Federation Cup is held across multiple sports in India. In athletics, it is a major national championship organised by the AFI.

QuestionText: Wrestler Sushil Kumar won back-to-back Olympic medals — bronze in 2008 and silver in 2012 — in which weight category?
Explanation: Sushil Kumar won bronze (2008 Beijing) and silver (2012 London) in the 66 kg freestyle wrestling category.

QuestionText: Which country does India play the 'Desert Storm' cricket series against?
Options: A) Pakistan (historic rivalries in neutral venues)
Explanation: 'Desert Storm' refers to famous matches played in Sharjah between India and Pakistan in the 1980s–90s. Sachin Tendulkar's two centuries against Pakistan in 1998 are called the 'Desert Storm' knocks.
